answer: Ancient mollusc-like creature found in Morocco, 520 million years old.
evidence: Researchers discovered it after looking back at some fossils found in the late 2000s in Morocco, North Africa. Two of the fossils were in such good condition that the team were able to make this amazingly detailed reconstruction. You can clearly see its small mouth filled with hundreds of teeth and the prickly spines which cover its body. This slug like creature also had a built in, helmet like, shell to keep it safe from predators.
